tax_litigation.status: The Company had filed a petition with ITAT to withdraw the appeal relating to AY 2020-21 relating to the MAT credit u/s 115JAA and ITAT accepted our petition and dismissed the appeal in relation to this matter. Accordingly, ITAT passed an order dated 11-03-2026 directing the AO to delete the TP adjustment made on guarantee fee and the adjustment of interest on overdue receivables from AEs.

tax_litigation.status: “Internal Revenue Service (“IRS”), USA issued a notice dated June 15, 2026 on Ramco Systems Corporation, USA (“RSC”), a subsidiary of the Company, received by RSC on July 1, 2026, levying a civil penalty of USD 0.34 Mln. (Approximately Rs.32 Mln.), in connection with the filing of international information returns (Forms 5471 and 5472) for FY 2024-25. The matter arose due to the IRS treating certain information returns as filed beyond the prescribed due date following an electronic filing rejection and subsequent resubmission, which was beyond the control of the RSC. Further, IRS Letter 854C (Penalty Waiver or Abatement Disallowed/Appeals Procedure Explained) dated September 1, 2026, issued by the IRS, rejecting its request for penalty abatement. Accordingly, a formal protest and request for an Appeals Conference has been filed through its tax advisors on October 26, 2026, seeking full abatement of the penalty and interest. The matter is currently pending before the IRS Appeals process. Management believes it has valid grounds to contest the levy and is pursuing available remedies. The matter does not have any impact on the operations of the Company or its subsidiary.”
